notes: SEQN is the NHANES respondent identifier, mapped to person_source_value to preserve the original identifier.
Food/individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall. Stored as value_as_number with a custom observation_concept_id.
Dietary day one sample weight is a continuous numeric weight for survey analysis. Mapped to observation value_as_number.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a continuous numeric weight. Mapped to observation value_as_number.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/reliability. Mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Mapped to observation value_as_string as it is not a standard person identifier.
Breast-fed infant indicator (binary). Mapped to value_as_concept_id using a custom Yes/No concept.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Mapped to observation value_as_number.
Intake day of week is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id using a custom concept for days of week.
Language used mostly is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom language concept.
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier. Mapped to observation value_as_number.
Combination food type is categorical text. Mapped to observation value_as_string.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) is a time of day. OMOP does not have a dedicated time field, so stored as value_as_string or could be converted to numeric minutes.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch) is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept for meal type.
Source of food (e.g., store, restaurant) is categorical. Mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept for food source.
Categorical context about meal location. Could map to a custom concept for 'eaten at home' (e.g., Yes/No). No direct standard concept_id without custom mapping.
USDA food code is a source identifier. Store as source value; map to standard food concept if available, else null.
Modification code indicates food modification (e.g., fortified, unsalted). Requires custom mapping to standard concepts.
Grams of food consumed. Map to a Measurement concept for 'Food weight' (e.g., 44818760). Unit concept_id for gram (8587).
Energy in kcal. Standard concept_id for 'Energy' (4306068). Unit concept_id for kilocalorie (9546).
Protein in grams. Standard concept_id for 'Protein' (4075853). Unit concept_id for gram (8587).
